in_marathi.name: Bhumi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhumi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhumi is a Sanskrit word meaning 'earth' or 'soil'. In Hindu mythology, Bhumi Devi is a goddess representing the earth element. The name is also associated with the earth as a symbol of stability, nourishment, and growth.

vedic_reference.note: Bhumi is the Hindu goddess of the Earth. She is the wife of Vishnu and is also known as Prithvi, Bhu Devi, and Bhumi Devi. She is one of the Shaktis (powers) of the Goddess Durga.
